svg.title: ShahTunnel v2.1.0 network flow
svg.desc: Public TCP clients enter the Hub. The Hub and Agent communicate over one of four implemented transport lanes: TCP/TLS, WebSocket/TLS, HTTP/2 CONNECT, or HTTP/1.1 CONNECT. The Agent forwards traffic to configured local targets.
svg.text: Reverse TCP relay · Adaptive transport recovery · Hub ↔ Agent
Adaptive tries the last successful path first
Traffic delivered to matching target ID
Open only the TCP ports required by the selected transport policy.
Security: token authentication · TLS 1.3 · SHA-256 certificate fingerprint pinning
Failover reconnects an interrupted lane through the next candidate; it does not migrate an already-open TCP stream in place.
